item: lookups and datagrams that bypass getaddrinfo meet the airplane rule
summary: While airplane mode is engaged, socket.gethostbyname/_ex, gethostbyaddr (so getfqdn), getnameinfo, bind given a host name and sendto/sendmsg given one get R639's rule (no name, exactly localhost answered from its literal, or a loopback literal pass; an alias is refused in fixed words; anything else is refused before libc), and sendto/sendmsg (and a PySocks UDP sendto through a proxy) to a non-loopback destination is refused. Release line: with airplane mode on, the app can no longer be made to look up a name or send a single network datagram through the less common socket calls it did not watch before.
